description: This file defines a database migration class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 5.0.0 beta. It contains methods to modify the database schema, update configuration settings, and configure email templates and permissions during the migration process.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Installer\Migration\V5_0_0_beta\Migration
classes.description: Database migration class for updating schema, data, and configuration for OrangeHRM version 5.0.0 beta.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the database schema updates, data modifications, and configuration changes required for the migration to version 5.0.0 beta.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version identifier string for this migration, '5.0-beta'.

methods.name: updateHomePage
methods.description: Helper method to update the home page URL for a given user role.

methods.name: getEmailIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the email ID from the database for a given email name, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: updateEmailProcessorClassByEmailName
methods.description: Updates the class responsible for processing a specific email by email name.

methods.name: updateEmailTemplateSubjectAndBodyByEmailNameAndRecipientRole
methods.description: Updates the subject and body templates for a specific email and recipient role.

methods.name: getReportDisplayGroupId
methods.description: Fetches the ID of a report display group by name, caching the result.

methods.name: updateReportDisplayFieldByGroup
methods.description: Updates display fields for a specific report group to point to a new class.

methods.name: updateReportFilterFieldByFieldName
methods.description: Updates the class responsible for filtering a specific report field.

methods.name: renameReportDisplayFieldAlias
methods.description: Changes the alias name of a report display field.

methods.name: renameSelectedReportFilterFieldWhereCondition
methods.description: Renames the where condition string used in report filters.

methods.name: updateReportDisplayFieldByFieldAlias
methods.description: Updates the class responsible for a display field identified by its alias.

methods.name: updateScreenModuleId
methods.description: Associates a screen's action URL with a specific module ID and name.

methods.name: updateMenuItemIconNames
methods.description: Updates the icon name associated with a menu item based on its title.
